text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Aaah...! Lady Ramonu lost. So much for the 
Triple Tiara, huh!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: ... Doesn't that mean, like...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
—If even the great Ramonu-sama couldn't 
reach it, the Triple Tiara must really be 
something incredible.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Lady Ramonu's own strength is the real 
deal! She will surely capture the 
remaining two crowns...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text:
"...Even so, it's Ramonu-san. She really 
is amazing, after all."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text:
“Still, even after... everything I worked 
for.”

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text: ...Must be nice.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text:
"Strength, beauty, pride... She has... 
every single one of them..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —Phew.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Deplorable.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, no one will even give me a 
second glance...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text:
...All anyone cares about is Ramonu-san. 
Even she herself...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text:
—Even someone like me. Even I... 
surely—could have reached it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
"...Even so, your role does not change. 
You understand this, Ramonu—"

When Mejiro Ramonu returned after the 
race, she was unusually irritated... Or 
rather—she practically exuded bloodlust.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Just a moment. Please wait for me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
choice_data_list: ...It's not the end of everything, is it?
...It's not the end of everything, is it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I'm pathetic, aren't I...? Getting so down 
in the dumps.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: "She saw right through my arrogance."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
To say you love racing more than anyone 
else... If that were true, winning would 
be a given.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Ah, I wonder if she hates me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...You're right. Indeed, you are.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"It's impossible for her to dislike 
anything specific. She will simply look... 
only at what has reached her."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Phew...

As Mejiro Ramonu let out a breath... she 
returned to her usual composed self. Looks 
like she'll be just fine.
choice_data_list: Did you enjoy the race itself?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
It is a cherry blossom that everyone looks 
up to... It truly is a beautiful thing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the fervor will burn even 
brighter. All that remains—is for this 
body to be fully primed.

After finishing getting ready to go 
home...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Lady Ramonu~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your hard work~. That was a 
wonderful run~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Oh, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Ramonu-san when she's running. She was 
so dazzling, and so very cool.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I... still haven't decided on my own path 
yet, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I want to run proudly and majestically... 
just like Ms. Ramonu!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...S-Sorry to bother you when you're 
tired. Pardon me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Giggle.
choice_data_list: You really are someone to admire, huh
You really are someone to look up to.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Seems to be the case.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Warmth is nice, of course... but I'm also 
looking forward to a piercing, sharp 
pain."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure... the next race will have that 
very thing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: "The Oaks"... We'll meet again soon.

And so, with her spirits completely 
undaunted... we head into the second leg 
of the Tiara route, the Oaks!
